items.title: Amway Next Gen Checkout Project Technology Stack
items.description: An onboarding and architecture map for a Java 21 and Quarkus checkout stack using PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Argo CD, Dynatrace, SonarQube, and JaCoCo.

items.title: Build A Failure-Aware Checkout Service With Quarkus
items.description: Hands-on capstone modeling account and profile context, idempotent checkout, PostgreSQL transactions, outbox events, Kafka outcomes, authorization, testing, and recovery in Quarkus.

items.title: Generate And Verify OpenAPI From Quarkus
items.description: Intermediate tutorial for documenting a Quarkus provider, exporting its contract, and preventing implementation-to-contract drift.

items.title: Generate, Package, And Consume Quarkus OpenAPI Clients
items.description: Advanced tutorial for generated Quarkus REST clients, Maven contract artifacts, compatibility gates, security, and release operations.

items.title: OpenAPI Contracts And Generated DTO Artifacts
items.description: A contract-first retail tutorial for defining checkout APIs, generating Java DTOs with Gradle Kotlin DSL, publishing versioned artifacts, and consuming them from Quarkus projects.

items.title: OpenAPI Fundamentals For Quarkus
items.description: Beginner tutorial explaining OpenAPI, Swagger UI, contracts, schemas, operations, and a first Quarkus API description.

items.title: Quarkus Beginner-To-Advanced Learning Path
items.description: A progressive Quarkus route covering foundations, REST, OpenAPI, generated clients, persistence, messaging, security, observability, native images, Kubernetes, and checkout design.

items.title: Quarkus Data, Transactions, And Testing
items.description: Intermediate-to-advanced tutorial for Hibernate ORM with Panache, schema migration, transaction boundaries, idempotency, outbox persistence, Dev Services, and Quarkus test layers.

items.title: Quarkus Foundations: Runtime, Extensions, And Developer Workflow
items.description: Beginner tutorial for Quarkus project structure, extensions, build-time augmentation, dev mode, profiles, packaging, and framework selection.

items.title: Quarkus Messaging, Security, And Observability
items.description: Advanced tutorial for REST clients, timeouts and fault tolerance, Kafka messaging, OIDC authorization, health, metrics, logs, traces, and duplicate-safe processing.

items.title: Quarkus Native Images, Containers, And Kubernetes Production
items.description: Advanced production guide for JVM and native packaging, container images, Kubernetes resources, health probes, graceful shutdown, capacity, security, and diagnostics.

items.title: Quarkus REST, CDI, Configuration, And Validation
items.description: Application-level tutorial for Jakarta REST resources, Jackson JSON, CDI scopes and injection, typed configuration, validation, errors, and blocking versus reactive execution.
